title: pi-continual-harness configuration (harness.json)
description: Optional configuration for the pi-continual-harness extension, at ~/.pi/agent/harness.json. Missing file → defaults; unknown keys are ignored by the loader (forward-compatible).

autoImport.description: Opt-in durable sync. true bundles session_start layered auto-import (global + current project) and turn_end auto-export whenever the live store changed.

importRemind.description: Awareness reminders for durable imports (effective only when autoImport is on).

remindRefine.description: The /refine activation nudge (notify-only, never mutates state).

detailEvery.description: Every Nth fired reminder is the detailed guide instead of the one-line nudge (1 = every reminder).

commit.description: Export durable layers before the steering message so the agent refines against the on-disk view.

gate.description: Classifier gate (needs classifier.model): one cheap yes/no question before a cadence refine; skips it when nothing durable-looking happened. Soft-fails to the plain cadence on classifier errors.

omitStaleDrafts.description: Omit prior auto-refine request drafts from future provider context (at most one, the newest, stays model-visible). Raw history and /tree rollback are untouched.

classifier.description: Classifier model for the cheap gated paths.

model.description: "provider/id" or a bare id of a classifier catalog entry (e.g. "typesafe/jev-latest" or a local llama.cpp classifier). Unset/unresolvable → every classifier feature degrades to its no-classifier behavior.

virtualBinding.description: How the model-binding key treats virtual (router) models. "virtual": key = the selection's own provider/id. "physical": key = the physical model behind the latest successful response.

proposer.description: Delta proposer name from the registry. Builtins: "steering" (agent reasons via a steering message) and "dedupe" (rule-based merge). Companion packages may register more via registerProposer().

outcomeImportance.description: Opt-in turn_end outcome loop: bump importance of items the agent references by their [h_xxxx] tag.

injection.description: Selection policy for WHAT gets surfaced in the system block each provider request.

enabled.description: false restores the legacy "inject all items, in store order" behavior.

threshold.description: Token-overlap level at which two items sharing the key fields (kind, owner model, durable layer) count as duplicates.

merge.description: true merges each duplicate into its keeper (evidence union) as one audited update+delete pair; false restores delete-only.
